title: National Risk Rankings Change With The Metric
hook: One danger shrank, another exploded, and a third changed leaders.
closing: The metric you choose can redraw which country appears most at risk.
question: Which national risk matters most?

segments.say: The homicide rate fell to 5.2 per hundred-thousand people. One national danger eased while other pressures moved elsewhere.
Ukraine recorded 68,097 battle-related deaths. National danger looks completely different when war replaces ordinary crime.
Greece led with 23,795 heating degree days. National pressure shifts again when climate replaces violence.
